title: Minimalist Coaster
description: A fast circular project for learning rounds, joining, and simple stitch repetition.
expectationText: A quick round project where you practice building a flat circle, joining neatly, and finishing something useful in one short sitting.

steps.title: Make a center ring
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring or chain 4 and join into a loop.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 8 single crochet into the ring and join with a slip stitch.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Work 2 single crochet into each stitch around for 16 stitches total.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Alternate 1 single crochet, then 2 single crochet in the next stitch around.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Slip stitch to join, fasten off, and weave in the end.
